template:
<group name="show_system_detail.chassis">
!#### show system detail ####{{_start_}}

Product: {{model}}, System Uptime:{{uptime |ORPHRASE | _start_}}
        Chassis Serial_No: {{chassis_serial}}	Part_No: {{part_number}}
        Manuf Serial_No: {{manf_serial}}
        <group name="pems">
        PEM_{{position}} Serial_No: {{serial}}     Part_No: {{part_number}}
        </group>
        <group name="fans">
        FAN_{{position}} Serial_No: {{serial}}     Part_No: {{part_number}}
        </group>
        System Time: {{system_time | ORPHRASE}}
        128MHz, 3 PPM Crystal Clock
  <group name="line_cards">
        Module {{slot | to_int}}, {{master_slave | re('Master|Slave')}} {{model}}, Status {{status}}
        Module {{slot | to_int | _start_}} {{model}} {{status}} ({{port_config|ORPHRASE}})
        Module {{slot | to_int | let('status', 'Not Present')| _start_}} Not Present
        Major rev {{major}}, Minor rev {{minor}}
        Serial_No: {{serial}} Part_No: {{part_number}}
        CFE version {{cfe_version}}
        Uptime: {{uptime | ORPHRASE}}
        Docsis channel: {{docsis_30_qams | to_int}}
        Video channel: {{video_qams|to_int}}
        Broadcast channel: {{broadcast_qams|to_int}}
        OFDM spectrum: {{ofdm_spectrum|to_int}}MHz
        <group name="io">
        {{model}} Serial_No: {{serial}} Part_No: {{part_number}}
        Major rev {{major}}, Minor rev {{minor}}
        </group>
        
  </group>
</group>
